button.note: Figma kit measures a 26px corner radius across every sampled size (default/sm/lg x default/outline/ghost/destructive/secondary/link); replaces the shared base string's rounded-md (8px).
Figma measures a 6px icon-label gap on the default and lg sizes (itemSpacing spacing/1-5); replaces the shared base string's gap-2 (8px).

Figma sm size measures a 4px gap (itemSpacing spacing/1); replaces the sm size's own literal gap-1.5 (6px). Distinct from the base gap-2 rewrite above: this matches the raw upstream token that already reads "gap-1.5" in the sm size string.
Figma default size measures 12px horizontal padding; replaces the default size's px-4 (16px).

button.from: text-sm (default size, inherited from the base string)
button.note: Documentation only — this "from" never matches a real upstream token, so it does not affect the gate (text-xs is already required from size=xs). Figma sm size measures a 12/16px label (text-xs) vs the shared base's text-sm (14/20); button.twig adds an explicit text-xs to the sm size map alongside the inherited text-sm, mirroring how upstream's own xs size already layers text-xs over the base text-sm.

input.note: Figma's Default state has no effect (effects: []); dropped. The Invalid state's ring-like shadow is a separate destructive effect already covered by aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20.

textarea.note: Figma measures 12px vertical padding; replaces py-2 (8px).
Figma's Default state has no effect (effects: []); dropped. The Invalid state's ring-like shadow is a separate destructive effect already covered by aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20.

progress.note: Upstream drives the fill width with an inline style={{ transform: translateX(...) }} computed in React; the Twig port sets the value through the module (a CSS custom property) and animates it in progress.css instead, so this utility is not required verbatim in the twig markup. Revisit once the module lands.

aspect-ratio.note: Upstream (Radix AspectRatioPrimitive.Root) renders no Tailwind classes at all — the ratio is a runtime inline style computed by Radix, not a class string. With no Radix runtime here, the box uses Tailwind's native aspect-* utilities instead (aspect-video/aspect-square/aspect-[4/3]/aspect-[3/2]/aspect-[21/9]), selected from a literal enum map so the class scanner sees them; not comparable 1:1 to upstream.

kbd.note: Figma measures a 22px key height (bound.height = "height/h-5,5"); replaces upstream's h-5 (20px).
Figma measures 6px horizontal padding; replaces upstream's px-1 (4px).
Figma's own bound.minWidth token is "width/w-5,5" (22px), matching the measured height so single-character keys render as a 22x22 square; replaces upstream's min-w-5 (20px).

item.note: Figma's main/default kit instance is the Outline card, which measures an 18px corner radius (rounded-2xl); replaces the shared base string's rounded-md (8px), applied to every color variant since itemVariants only varies background/border per variant, not radius. The plain 'Default' (no-border) sample measures a different 10px radius (node 18709:106332) — kept as a documented conflict, not applied, since the base string cannot express two radii and the kit's main component (Outline) wins.
Figma measures a 10px gap on both the Outline (node 18672:218681) and Default (node 18709:106332) samples of size=default; replaces the default size's gap-4 (16px).

Figma measures asymmetric padding on size=default (16px horizontal / 14px vertical, consistent across the Outline and Default samples): the p-4 shorthand is dropped and item.twig writes the two explicit utilities instead (px-4, unchanged at 16px, and py-3.5 = 14px). The check:classes gate can only express a 1:1 token swap, not a shorthand split, so px-4/py-3.5 show as EXTRA (expected) rather than matched against this exception.

empty.note: Figma measures an 18px corner radius on the Empty root; replaces rounded-lg (10px in this kit's radius scale). The emptyMediaVariants icon variant also uses the literal token rounded-lg upstream but measures a different 14px radius there (node I18679:26096;18672:1850, -> rounded-xl); check:classes only tracks de-duplicated tokens per component (not per owner), so that second, distinct rounded-lg->rounded-xl swap is applied directly in empty.twig without its own exception entry and shows as an EXTRA (expected) token instead.
Figma measures a 16px gap between empty-header and empty-content; replaces gap-6 (24px).

calendar.note: react-day-picker (upstream) is replaced end-to-end by vanilla-calendar-pro; class strings are not comparable 1:1. See PORTING.md Adaptation table / docs/adr/0002-native-html-apis-instead-of-radix.md.

chart.note: recharts (upstream) is replaced end-to-end by chart.js; class strings are not comparable 1:1. See PORTING.md Adaptation table / docs/adr/0002-native-html-apis-instead-of-radix.md.

table.note: Figma table kit measures a 48px head row height; replaces TableHead's h-10 (40px). TableCell has no own h-* token upstream (height comes from padding) — the 44px cell height fact is applied directly in table.twig as an added h-11 utility, not an exception (EXTRA, expected, same convention as item's px-4/py-3.5 split).
Figma table kit measures 12px horizontal padding on both head and cell; replaces px-2 (8px) wherever it occurs in table.tsx (TableHead and TableCell).

TableCell's own token is the p-2 shorthand (8px all sides); the 12px horizontal / 44px total row height facts can't be expressed as a single shorthand replacement, so table.twig writes the two explicit utilities instead (px-3, already covered by the px-2->px-3 exception above, and py-2 + an added h-11 for the 44px row height — same shorthand-split convention as item's p-4 -> px-4/py-3.5).

input-group.note: Kit measures a 26px corner radius on the input-group container wrapping an <input> (pill, matching base/button's own rounded-4xl radius token); height (36px, h-9) and the container's own padding/gap already match upstream. The diff-figma-upstream.mjs proposal for this node (h-4/px-0/py-0, ~16px) was discarded as not-applied — it conflates the container with a smaller nested part (likely an icon-only addon), not the group root; the 26px radius given here follows the task brief's corrected measurement instead. A textarea-in-group measures 18px (rounded-2xl, matching base/textarea's own radius) rather than 26px: since the base string can't express two radii, this is added directly in input-group.twig as an extra has-[>textarea]:rounded-2xl utility (EXTRA, not a second exception).

field.note: Figma kit measures a 12px gap between stacked fields inside a field-set; replaces FieldSet's gap-6 (24px). Field's own gap (fieldVariants base) is already gap-3 (12px) upstream, matching the kit's "field gap 12" fact with no change needed. FieldLabel/FieldTitle text ("label 14/20") already matches upstream's text-sm (14px) + leading-snug (~20px) — no override needed. The diff-figma-upstream.mjs proposals h-5->h-25 (absurd 100px), px-2->px-0 and rounded-md->rounded-xs (this node's only real conditional rounded-md is FieldLabel's card-style has-[>[data-slot=field]] variant, unrelated to the measured 0-radius node) were discarded as not-applied — noise from a single-node measurement that doesn't map to any of field.tsx's own literal tokens.

pagination.note: Upstream wraps the Previous/Next text in a <span className="hidden sm:block"> to hide it below sm; base/button/button.twig's label is a plain <span> with no per-run class hook (same limitation as item.twig/attachment noted in docs/reports/phase-4-b2a-static.md, follow-up B8), so the label is always visible here instead of hidden on mobile.
See the 'hidden' exception above — same span, dropped as a pair.

combobox.note: Upstream combobox is Base UI (not a new-york-v4 Radix primitive); the Twig port composes input-group + floating.js with its own module, so upstream classes are not comparable 1:1.

dialog.note: Radix's Overlay div has no host on this platform: the native <dialog> ::backdrop pseudo-element already covers the full viewport via the UA default stylesheet (position:fixed; inset:0), so the overlay's own inset-0 has nothing to attach to.

The overlay div itself does not exist (no Portal/Radix runtime); its background color becomes a `backdrop:` utility on the native <dialog>. The overlay fade classes are dropped from the backdrop — the panel keeps its own (unprefixed) fade/zoom, per PORTING.md Adaptation table ("dialog overlay <div> -> backdrop: utilities on <dialog>").

tooltip.note: Figma kit measures a 14px corner radius on every sampled side (bound token border-radius/rounded-xl); replaces upstream's rounded-md (6px). Padding (spacing/3 + spacing/1-5 = px-3 py-1.5) and text (12/16 = text-xs) already match upstream verbatim, no override needed there.

dropdown-menu.note: Figma kit measures a 22px corner radius on the menu container (bound token border-radius/rounded-3xl); replaces upstream's rounded-md (6px) on dropdown-menu-content and dropdown-menu-sub-content (the kit has no separate submenu shape, the sub panel is the same container).

Figma's menu container carries the two-layer drop shadow bound to the shadow/lg token (effects: "shadow/lg/1/offset-x"); replaces dropdown-menu-content's shadow-md. dropdown-menu-sub-content already reads shadow-lg upstream, so the two panels now agree.

Figma measures an 18px corner radius on every sampled item shape (bound token border-radius/rounded-2xl, consistent across Variant=Shortcut/Default/Distructive and State=Default/Disabled); replaces upstream's rounded-sm (2px) on item, checkbox-item, radio-item and sub-trigger.
Figma measures 12px horizontal item padding (bound paddingLeft/paddingRight = spacing/3); replaces px-2 (8px) on item, sub-trigger and label.

Figma measures 8px vertical item padding (bound paddingTop/paddingBottom = spacing/2), which together with the 20px text line box yields the kit's 36px item height, so no extra h-9 is added. Not applied to dropdown-menu-label, which measures 10px (node 330:28602, spacing/2-5): the gate matches tokens per component, not per owner, and the item is the dominant shape — the 2px label difference is accepted rather than split into a second EXTRA utility.

dropdown-menu.from: text-sm (dropdown-menu-label only, inherited from the shared item token)
dropdown-menu.note: Documentation only — this "from" never matches a real upstream token, so it does not affect the gate. Figma's Label shape measures a 12/16px text (textStyle text-xs/leading-normal/medium, bound text/xs/font-size) while every item measures 14/20 (text-sm); since both share the literal token text-sm upstream, dropdown-menu.twig writes text-xs directly on the label (reported as EXTRA, expected — same convention as item's px-4/py-3.5 split). Not applied: the diff-figma-upstream.mjs proposal gap-2 -> gap-2.5, because the kit disagrees with itself (10px on nodes 91:278 / I21207:248417;...;97119, 8px on node I21207:248417;...;97011) — ambiguous, so upstream's gap-2 stands. Also not applied: an explicit h-9, already produced by py-2 + the 20px line box.

select.note: Figma measures a 22px corner radius on the select trigger (bound token border-radius/rounded-3xl) and the same 22px on the menu container (node 21141:29349); replaces upstream's rounded-md (6px) on select-trigger and select-content.
Figma's Select / Menu container carries the two-layer drop shadow bound to the shadow/lg token (effects: "shadow/lg/1/offset-x"); replaces select-content's shadow-md.

Figma's trigger Default state has no effect (effects: []); dropped, same as base/input and base/textarea. The Invalid state's ring-like shadow (node 21141:30247, custom/destructive 20%) is a separate destructive effect already covered by aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20.
Figma measures an 18px corner radius on Select Menu / Item in every sampled variant and state (bound token border-radius/rounded-2xl); replaces upstream's rounded-sm (2px) on select-item.

Figma measures a 6px gap on both the trigger (bound itemSpacing spacing/1-5) and the item (node 118:2503, same token); replaces the bare gap-2 that select.tsx puts on those two shapes. Deliberately NOT applied to the variant forms *:data-[slot=select-value]:gap-2 and *:[span]:last:gap-2, which space the children INSIDE the value/item text (icon + text), a distance the kit never measures — those stay upstream.

Figma measures 12px horizontal padding on Select Menu / Label (bound paddingLeft/paddingRight = spacing/3); replaces select-label's px-2 (8px), matching the item's own 12px left padding so labels and options line up.

Figma measures 8px vertical item padding (bound paddingTop/paddingBottom = spacing/2), producing the kit's 36px item height together with the 20px text line box. Not applied to select-label, which measures 10px (node 118:2502, spacing/2-5): the gate matches tokens per component, not per owner, and the item is the dominant shape.

Upstream applies this to the Viewport only in position="popper", where Radix pairs it with its own item-aligned scrolling: it pins the scrollable area to the TRIGGER's height (36px), which without that runtime would show a single item at a time. The panel is sized by max-h-(--available-height) instead; --anchor-height is still written by common/floating.js and remains available to consumers. The sibling popper tokens (w-full, min-w-[var(--anchor-width)], scroll-my-1) are kept verbatim.

Figma measures 12px left item padding (bound paddingLeft = spacing/3); replaces select-item's pl-2 (8px). The 32px right padding (spacing/8) that makes room for the check indicator already matches upstream's pr-8. Not applied: the label's own 2px radius (border-radius/rounded-xs, node 118:2502) — select-label has no background or border upstream, so a radius there is invisible noise; and the kit's trigger fill (base/input) / transparent stroke, which contradicts upstream's bg-transparent + border-input and is a theme-level color decision, not a geometry measurement.
